task.title: Fix range sync framing for present empty event bodies

issue.title: id-events: preserve empty event bodies across range sync

payload.problem: Range-sync framing in merged PR #7657 conflates an absent event body with a present empty body. encode_record appends raw body bytes with no presence/length marker and decode_record maps an empty remainder to None. A valid header with payload_hash=BLAKE3(empty), payload_size=0 and Some([]) is accepted by ingest but arrives header-only after sync.
evidence: Current main pkgs/id/crates/id-events/src/event_store/sync.rs: encode_record appends the optional body without a marker; decode_record maps body.is_empty() to None.
The signed event format carries payload_hash and payload_size separately, so a present zero-byte payload is distinct from a header-only event; ingest_with_body verifies the empty body commitment.
PR #11265 adds a non-empty device-operation body sync test but leaves this framing unchanged. No later fix or duplicate issue was found.
acceptance: Range-sync framing distinguishes None from Some([]) and non-empty bodies.
A header-only event remains body-less after sync; a present empty body reads back as an empty Vec; a non-empty body remains byte-identical.
The receiver still checks payload hash and size before storing a body.
Tests name the three case oracles, including BLAKE3(empty) with payload_size 0.

exclude: Changing the signed event body format

tests: Add a range-sync round-trip test for None, Some(empty), and Some(non-empty); run the focused id-events sync tests through the required CI path.
payload.priority_reason: Data integrity bug in an already-merged generic event-body sync path; present-empty payloads are silently downgraded to header-only events.

dedupe.basis: No existing issue for present-empty event bodies in range sync was found; PR #11265 tests a non-empty body and current main retains the None/Some(empty) ambiguity.
